lines.japanese: 「夏だったらいいんだけど、冬だから風邪ひいちゃうかもー」
lines.english: “It'd be fine in summer, but it's winter. I might catch a cold.”

lines.japanese: ユーレイみたいな手ぇしたまま、目ぇつぶって動物みたいにアタマぶるぶるぶるってした。
lines.english: Her arms still dangling like a ghost's, she shut her eyes and shook her head like an animal drying itself.

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　そしたらさ、あ、あの、ポッポもこのままおふろ入っちゃえばいいんじゃない？　ねっ！」
lines.english: “Oh! Then, um… Poppo, why don't you just take your bath now too? Right?”

lines.japanese: おれはドキドキがバレないかドキドキしながらゆった。小ばとが目ぇを上げる。
lines.english: I was nervous she'd notice how nervous I was. Kobato raised her eyes.

lines.japanese: 「えー」
lines.english: “Umm…”

lines.japanese: やっぱイヤそうなカオだ。でも、なんか、さっきろうかで話したときほどはイヤそうじゃない気ぃもする。
lines.english: She still looked reluctant. But maybe not quite as reluctant as when we'd talked in the hallway.

lines.japanese: 「だからさ、きょうだいなんだからさ、おふろぐらい全ぜんヘンじゃないよ。全ぜんヘンじゃないよ」
lines.english: “I mean, we're brother and sister. There's nothing strange about taking a bath. Nothing strange at all.”

lines.japanese: おれはひっしこいてセットクした。
lines.english: I tried as hard as I could to persuade her.

lines.japanese: 「すげーもう、全ぜんヘンじゃないよ。いのちかけてもいいよ。だってきょうだいだもん、全ぜんヘンじゃないよ。はずかしがる方がヘンだよ、はずかしがるヤツはアタマいかれてんだよ。全ぜんヘンじゃないよ」
lines.english: “Really, it isn't strange at all. I'd bet my life on it. We're brother and sister, so it isn't strange. Acting embarrassed is stranger. Anybody who thinks it's strange is the weird one. There's nothing strange about it.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ、だってこの前、４がい区の河嶋んち、妹もう小学校あがってんのに、河嶋といっしょにフロ入るってゆってたも。だから全ぜんヘンじゃないよ。ヘンとかゆうヤツがヘンなんだよ、アタマいかれてんだよ」
lines.english: “Right! Kawashima said just the other day that he still takes baths with his little sister, even though she's already in elementary school. So it isn't strange at all. Anybody who says it is is the strange one. They're crazy.”

lines.japanese: 「う、ううん、そうかなあ……」
lines.english: “M-maybe you're right…”

lines.japanese: 小ばとはフルフルさむそうに、ぬれた肩とか太モモをシュリシュリこすりながらゆった。
lines.english: Kobato shivered with cold and rubbed at her wet shoulders and legs.

lines.japanese: 「うーん……あの、え、お兄ちゃんって、今いくつなんだっけ」
lines.english: “Hmm… Um, Big Brother, how old are you again?”

lines.japanese: 「あい？　おれ？　だから、こんぐらいだってば」
lines.english: “Huh? Me? I told you—about this old.”

lines.japanese: おれはさっきと同じでパーをふたつ見せた。それを見て小ばとは「んー」ってうなった。
lines.english: I held up two open hands again. Kobato looked at them and hummed thoughtfully.

lines.japanese: 「たしかに……そっかあ、そのぐらいなら……べつに変じゃないかー」
lines.english: “I suppose… Yeah, if you're that age… maybe it isn't strange.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだよ、全ぜんヘンじゃないよ、ヘンとかゆうヤツはそいつがヘンなんだよ、アタマいかれてんだよ」
lines.english: “Right. It isn't strange at all. Anybody who says it is is the strange one. They're crazy.”

lines.japanese: 小ばとはシュリシュリしながらどんどん体を丸めてった。さむそうだったから、あと、どうせもうビショぬれだったから、おれはシャワー雨を小ばとにかけてやった。
lines.english: Still rubbing herself for warmth, Kobato curled tighter and tighter. She looked cold, and she was already soaked anyway, so I turned the warm shower spray over her.

lines.japanese: 「ひゃっ……あ、あは、あったかーい」
lines.english: “Eek… Oh—ahh, that's warm.”

lines.japanese: 「でしょー。ほらもー、ぬいじゃいなってー。ねー、兄ちゃん、久しぶりに背中ながしてやっからよー」
lines.english: “See? Come on, get out of those wet clothes. Your big brother hasn't scrubbed your back in forever.”

lines.japanese: 「う、うん……そ、お？」
lines.english: “O-okay… I guess?”

lines.japanese: 小ばとが真下っからジッとこっち見て、そんで、はずかしそうにクスッてわらった。
lines.english: Kobato looked straight up at me, then gave a shy little laugh.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ、うん、お兄ちゃんに流してもらおっかな、えへへっ……」
lines.english: “Then… okay. Maybe I'll let my big brother wash my back. Heh heh…”

lines.japanese: 「えへへー」
lines.english: “Heh heh.”

lines.japanese: おれもいっしょにわらった。だって、なんかうれしくて、しぜんとニコニコしてきちゃう。
lines.english: I laughed with her. I couldn't help smiling, because for some reason I was happy.

lines.japanese: 「えへへ、はいポッポ脱ぐよー、バンザイしてー」
lines.english: “Okay, Poppo. Arms up—let's get those wet clothes off.”

lines.japanese: 「いっ、いいよう、自分でぬげるよう」
lines.english: “I-it's fine! I can do it myself.”

lines.japanese: 「くふふ、じゃあ下はぬがせてあげるね」
lines.english: “Heh heh. Then I’ll help take off the bottom.”

lines.japanese: 「し、下もだいじょぶだってばあ」
lines.english: “I-I said I can do the bottom myself!”

lines.japanese: ちぇっ。どうせならおれが妹の服ぬがせたかったな。
lines.english: Aw. If she was getting undressed anyway, I wanted to be the one to undress my little sister.

lines.japanese: でも小ばとは、ちょっとモジモジしながら、ちゃんと自分で全部ぬいだ。
lines.english: But after a little embarrassed fidgeting, Kobato properly took everything off herself.

lines.japanese: 「うひょーっ！」
lines.english: “Whoa!”

lines.japanese: やっと妹のおっぱいが直で見れて、おれは超かんどうした。
lines.english: At last I got to see my little sister’s bare breasts, and I was incredibly moved.

lines.japanese: 「……え？　お兄ちゃんいま『うひょー』ってゆった？」
lines.english: “…What? Big Brother, did you just say ‘whoa’?”

lines.japanese: 「んーん？　ゆってないよ？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Nope.”

lines.japanese: おれはしらばっくれて、ざらざらタオルに石けんをいっぱい付けた。へへへ、おっぱい見してくれたお礼に、兄ちゃんが小ばとの背中ピカピカにしてあげるんだ。
lines.english: I played innocent and loaded the rough washcloth with soap. Heh heh. To thank her for showing me her boobs, her big brother would scrub Kobato’s back until it shone.

lines.japanese: 「はいポッポぉ、ここすわってー」
lines.english: “Okay, Poppo. Sit right here.”

lines.japanese: おれは妹をよびながら、おふろイスをポンポンたたいた。こんなの、きょうだいなんだから全ぜんヘンじゃない。ヘンとかゆうヤツはそいつがヘンなんだ。アタマいかれてるんだ。
lines.english: I called my little sister over and patted the bath stool. There was nothing strange about any of this. We were brother and sister. Anybody who said it was strange was the strange one. They were crazy.
